evidence_handle_resolution.policy: Handles must map to admitted canonical keys (file: or cluster:) in the task store. Unknown or malformed handles fail closed with EVIDENCE_REF_INVALID.

hypothesis_semantics.unverified_hypotheses: Allowed in working state as hypotheses with appropriate open/in_progress status; never promoted to confirmed fact without admissible evidence basis.
hypothesis_semantics.unsupported_facts: Transition proposals attempting to declare facts or answer questions without basis_refs are rejected by StateTransitionPolicy with QUESTION_CLOSURE_BASIS_REQUIRED.

analyst_notes_separation.rule: Analyst notes and user directives are strictly contextual inputs; they cannot be accepted as evidence handles or bypass GroundingValidator.

finalization_and_report_evidence.finalization_gate: Explicit only. Cycle execution does not evaluate FinalizationGate unless explicitly invoked.
finalization_and_report_evidence.report_admission: Zero admissions to report_evidence table during agent cycle.
